name: Waladgaon

queries.query: Waladgaon Maharashtra cadastral parcel map official land records
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Maharashtra Bhumi Abhilekh/BhuNaksha as the official public land-record map lead. Government of India Census evidence identifies Waladgaon in Aurangabad district, Maharashtra, with village code 548872. No public parcel JSON/API response was exposed by discovery.

queries.result: First-party Marathi discovery identified Maharashtra Bhumi Abhilekh services describing Bhu-Naksha, village maps, survey-number maps, and land-record services. The indexed official BhuNaksha interface exposes district/taluka/village and plot-number selection, but no bounded parcel response or public API schema was available.

registryEvidence: The official Maharashtra Bhumi Abhilekh portal lists Bhu-Naksha/e-map and survey-number map services, while the official Maharashtra village master identifies Waladgaon (village code 548872) and states that district, taluka, and village land-record master data are maintained by the Settlement Commissioner and Director of Land Records, Pune. This evidences a local/state registry custodian and public map lead, not a verified parcel API response.

officialSources.observation: Official Maharashtra BhuNaksha viewer; indexed interface exposes state/category/district/taluka/village selection and plot-number search. Direct TLS-verified retrieval timed out before JavaScript/configuration inspection.
Official Maharashtra Bhumi Abhilekh services page lists Bhu-Naksha/e-map, village maps, and survey-number map services.
Official Maharashtra village master portal; identifies the land-record department as the source/maintainer of district, taluka, and village data and links to BhuNaksha.
Government of India Census village directory identifies Waladgaon, Aurangabad, Maharashtra, village code 548872; contextual identity evidence only, not a parcel service.

source: Maharashtra Bhumi Abhilekh / BhuNaksha (public map lead; direct API not verified)

requestOutcomes.outcome: TLS-verified curl request timed out after 25 seconds with no response body; no JavaScript bundle, configuration, schema, CRS, parcel ID, or geometry was observed. No TLS exception was used.

The same official viewer route was confirmed by first-party indexed discovery, but the direct request could not be completed within the bounded request window. No parcel request was attempted without the viewer configuration.
First-party services page was available through web discovery and documented the Bhu-Naksha/survey-map service family; it did not expose a bounded anonymous parcel feature response.
First-party village master page was available and provided the official village-master scope and BhuNaksha link; no parcel geometry was requested or retained.
